title: Majority Vote Silences Minority Values: Annotator Disagreement at the Hate/Offensive Boundary in HateXplain

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing model accuracy and confidence (using hard labels, soft labels, and per-annotator heads) on culturally contested boundary cases in the HateXplain dataset where annotators disagree on hate vs. offensive speech, in order to demonstrate how majority-vote aggregation marginalizes minority annotator perspectives and values.
